description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Network Theory topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: network-theory

facts.claim: Nodal analysis applies KCL at each node

source.quote: Nodal analysis is essentially a systematic application of Kirchhoff's current law (KCL)

facts.claim: Branch currents at a node sum to zero

source.quote: the branch currents incident at a node must sum to zero

facts.claim: Any linear one-port reduces to one source and one impedance

source.quote: the theorem allows any one-port network to be reduced to a single voltage source and a single impedance

facts.claim: Vth is the open-circuit voltage

source.quote: The equivalent voltage Vth is the voltage obtained at terminals A–B of the network with terminals A–B open circuited

facts.claim: Larger load raises efficiency but lowers power

source.quote: If the load resistance is made larger than the source resistance, then efficiency increases

facts.claim: Swap source and response points: the current is the same

source.quote: the current at one point in a circuit due to a voltage at a second point is the same as the current at the second point

facts.claim: Valid for (almost all) passive networks

source.quote: The reciprocity theorem is valid for almost all passive networks

facts.claim: Differentiation and integration become multiplication and division

source.quote: converting differentiation and integration in the time domain into the algebraic operations multiplication and division

facts.claim: Models the output for each input (ratio of output to input)

source.quote: a mathematical function that models the system's output f

source.quote: The common models that are used are referred to as z-parameters, y-parameters, h-parameters, g-parameters, and ABCD-parameters

facts.claim: At resonance inductive and capacitive reactances cancel

source.quote: the impedances of the inductor and capacitor at resonant frequency are equal but of opposite sign and cancel out

facts.claim: Energy swaps between electric and magnetic fields

source.quote: in an electric field as the capacitor is charged and in a magnetic field

facts.claim: Low-pass passes frequencies below the cutoff

source.quote: A low-pass filter is a filter that passes signals with a frequency lower than a selected cutoff frequency

facts.claim: At cutoff, power is halved (−3 dB)

source.quote: at the cutoff frequency, the filter attenuates the input power by half or 3 dB

facts.claim: Symmetrical components analyse unbalanced systems

source.quote: The method of symmetrical components is used to analyze unbalanced systems
